proposal.rationale: The undetermined sections in Chapter 1-A are either REPEALED stubs (no text to scope), or sections about the regulatory process for proposing new regulation (§60-J, §60-K, §60-L — about "applicant groups" proposing regulation, not applying universally to licensees), or §59 which references "an occupational or professional licensing board established in Title 5, section 12004‑A" — a list of all Maine licensing boards. None of these contain phrases that fit a safe universal pattern. The REPEALED sections cannot be scoped. §60-J/K/L scope to applicant groups, not to licensees, so they should remain undetermined rather than be falsely marked universal. §59 references Title 5 §12004-A board list which would require a separate cross-reference resolver; I've added a cautious trigger pattern for "licensing board established in" in case it helps surface enumeration, but the actual board list is in Title 5 (out of Title 32 scope). Patterns remain unchanged otherwise — better to leave these undetermined for triage than to over-claim universality.
